scope: LAUNCH-only completed-block entry and frozen entry-known LP pool exits; no prices, wallet control, or executable trade claim
notes: 1/first-high-fee has no time window and begins at LAUNCH pool #2, not zero-fee pool #1.
2/60 starts at pools #3+#4; 2/120 through 2/600 start at pools #1+#2 and exclude zero-fee #1 from exit LP.
For n>=3, funded candidates and exits are copied from the read-only 24h chain matrix for the same block range.
